notes: Every town now has a mayor of its own, waiting at the town center to take deliveries for that town. Mayor Bram keeps his town; every other town gets its own mayor the next time someone visits it.
Towns pick their own building spots on natural ground and level it gently (never more than 3 blocks), and never touch anything you built, placed or planted.
As towns grow they build houses, lay grass paths to the center, light them with lantern posts and keep a garden pen with sheep and chickens.
Villagers now move into growing towns: 2 by the well, then a family for each house. They never take your bed, never harvest your crops and wander home when they stray.

town_bp.notes: A mayor per town, building spots the town picks and levels gently (at most 3 blocks, never your blocks), houses, paths, lantern posts, a garden pen whose animals come back if they wander off, and villagers who move in (Enabled), never take beds or harvest crops, and come home when they stray.

npc_bp.notes: Town mayors: each town can have its own mayor who takes deliveries for that town; mayors share town news.

welcome_bp.notes: The welcome page lists Town Projects: towns that grow as you help, each with its mayor.

admin_bp.notes: The setup checklist says towns pick their own project spots, so setting one is optional, and a spot an operator sets is never leveled.
